review_description: While the quoting process was long, Peter was enthusiastic about the product, it's performance & the whole company. He was able to answer all my questions & provided more documentation than I have ever been supplied.The installation was smooth, quick & the installers cleaned up after wards even vacuuming my garage floor. They were extremely polite, tidy & above all punctual. The installers even supplied me with their personal contact details should there be a problem.They are organising the grid connection, meter replacement & are even monitoring system performance.
The sales person explained in so much more detail than all the other sales people.
